reason: A DSH WebUI sidebar visualization that retrieves DeepSeek account balance and combines recorded token usage with built-in rates to estimate the current session cost.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页版侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、令牌用量和当前会话费用估算。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek account balance, token usage, and an estimate of the current session cost in the DSH web interface sidebar.

capabilities: Reads the active DeepSeek API key from DSH memory or configuration to request account balance data
Calls the official DeepSeek balance endpoint
Reads DSH-recorded token usage and calculates estimated per-session costs
Displays balance and estimated session cost in a persistent sidebar card
Refreshes balance data periodically or on demand
